### [`scene_unpack_bitmap`](../../../../src/scenes/scene_unpack.asm#L6) `$12CE`

*routine*

Unpacks the bitmap of scene stage_counter AND 3 backwards into $e640-$f53f. The data starts with its length. Called by scene_draw_if_new.
